chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me, saying: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Mahrawayh al-Qazwini narrated to us in the year three hundred and two, saying: Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Ghazi narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Musa (peace be upon them both) narrated to us, from his father, the righteous servant Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father al-Baqir Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Zayn al-Abidin Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father the martyr al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all), who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The best deeds in the sight of God are faith with no doubt in it, fighting in God's cause with no dishonesty about the spoils, and an accepted hajj.
And the first to enter Paradise will be an owned slave who perfected his worship of his Lord and was sincere to his master, and a chaste, self-restraining man of worship.

key_terms.إيمان: Iman: faith, sincere belief without doubt
key_terms.حج مبرور: Hajj mabrur: an accepted or blessed pilgrimage, performed with sincerity and piety
key_terms.عبد مملوك: Owned slave who demonstrates that status does not determine spiritual rank
key_terms.عفيف متعفف: Chaste and self-restraining, describing one who guards against both sin and temptation
key_terms.غلول: Ghulul: misappropriation of war spoils, a grave sin in Islamic law

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say are the best deeds in the sight of God?
ai.summary: In this hadith transmitted through the famous "golden chain" (silsilat al-dhahab) passing through all the Imams from Imam al-Rida (AS) back to Imam Ali (AS), the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) identifies three supreme deeds: sincere faith, honest fighting, and accepted pilgrimage. He also names two types of people who will be first to enter Paradise: a faithful slave who excels in worship and service, and a chaste worshipful man. This teaching was given in a context where the early Muslim community valued outward displays of piety, and the Prophet redirected attention to the inner quality and sincerity behind worship.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Mahrawayh al-Qazwini, in the year 302, reporting from Dawood ibn Suleiman al-Ghazi, that ‘Ali ibn Musa, peace be upon him, reported from his saintly father Musa ibn Ja’far, from his father al-Sadiq Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father al-Baqir Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, from his father Zainul Abideen ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Shaheed Al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali, from his father Amirul Mu’mineen ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "

The best act in the estimation of Allah, is to have faith unblemished by any doubt, and to fight in His way, without being dishonest about the spoils, and to perform Hajj, which is accepted into the grace of Allah.
And the slave who worships Allah in the best manner, remains sincere to his master and the one who is chaste, incorruptible and worshipful, will be the first to enter Paradise."
